scope: Original Nemesis basic-board standard semi-cooperative core, six original characters. Original English 28-page manual (including illustrations), official FAQ v2.2 base-game Rules/Actions/Rooms/Items, compatible supplemental wording in original publisher-hosted localizations. Optional modes, boards, campaigns and expansions excluded.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: When are Action hands refilled and the First Player token passed; what happens when the Action deck empties, and what are the normal discard destinations and visibility?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: At Player Phase start draw to 5, shuffle Action discard whenever required draw finds empty deck; then pass token left except first turn. Actions/Contamination to own Action discard, Items/Event/Attack/Serious Wounds to respective discard piles face up; markers to pools. Search example has explicit face-down return exception.
closest_old_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks card refill, token passing, deck exhaustion and discard destinations. Neither request nor key supplies repeated clockwise rounds or the all-passed gate.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: A Character in a burning Room takes one Action then passes. When do they take Fire damage, can they act again this Player Phase, can they discard cards, and do later players rounds burn them again?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: At end of own round take 1 Light Wound. Passing bars normal Actions this Player Phase, but official FAQ permits Interruption after passing. May discard any number of hand cards on passing. No further Fire wounds from later players rounds this turn.
closest_old_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks one Character taking an Action then passing, Fire damage, further Actions and discards. Explains individual pass consequences but not how all players rounds repeat or terminate the phase.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: After two Actions your hand is empty. Do you automatically pass then, and what timing consequence can Fire or Bleeding have?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: No automatic pass. Wait for next round to pass; can suffer Fire/Bleeding again because passing ends another round.
closest_old_requests.novelty_comparison: Assumes a two-Action round and asks when an empty-hand player passes. Its next-round timing does not ask who next acts or what collective condition starts Event Phase.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Give the Event Phase order, which Intruders move on an Event card, what controls movement and when the event effect resolves; what happens when Event and Intruder Attack decks run out?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Time and active Self-Destruct advance, Intruders in Combat attack, Fire Damage, Event card movement then effect, bag development fully resolved before next turn. closest_old_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks mutually exclusive Emergency Room treatment choices. Applying its OR structure to Canteen/Shower would give a wrong outcome; these Rooms provide their principal benefit AND an optional scan.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Does entering Room Covered With Slime require an Action to acquire Slime, can it have an Item Counter or Malfunction, can Slime stack, and does showering extinguish Fire?

Thus a Silence Exploration effect becomes Danger on that first entry, subject to the already-covered Careful Movement/Reconnaissance cancellation.
closest_old_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks Slime acquisition, counters/markers/stacking and whether Shower extinguishes Fire. Its key volunteers Shower removal, but stem does not request what Shower removes or whether scanning is additional.

Clothes costs 1 Action card and either discards a Slime marker OR dresses 1 Serious Wound. Choose one effect per Item use; both are Out of Combat Only and One Use Only, so discard the used Item.
